statement: Lease acquisition **shall** be an atomic check-then-insert under one lease-table mutex; a conflicting second owner for the same endpoint generation or the same `(endpoint, session)` **shall** be rejected (`LeaseStatus::Conflict`) with no mutation, and a concurrent race **shall** produce exactly one winner and one conflicted loser.
